name: vereinsvote
description: Crowdvoting platform for regional funding competitions

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,yellow "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p shared --noEmit && tsc -p server --noEmit && tsc -p web --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run test -w shared && npm run test -w server
